summary: Comprehensive frontend testing completed for Ramadan Iftar app. All 10 requested features passed successfully. The app correctly displays Day 1 of Ramadan 2026 (Feb 19, 2026) with countdown timer, prayer times, daily menu with 7 items, progress bar, city selector, theme toggle, and 29-day schedule modal.
passed_tests: ✅ Countdown timer working and counting down to Iftar time (18:32:XX)
✅ Daily Iftar Menu card displays exactly 7 menu items (soup, main, side, salad, 2 mezes, dessert)
✅ Menu shows Day 1 badge ('1. Gün') since today is Feb 19 (first day of Ramadan)
✅ Ramadan progress bar showing Day 1 and approximately 3% progress ('Ramazan'ın 1. günü — %3')
✅ Prayer times grid displays all 6 prayer times (İmsak, Güneş, Öğle, İkindi, Akşam, Yatsı)
✅ City selector works with 18 Turkish cities and saves preference to localStorage
✅ Theme toggle switches between dark (default) and light mode correctly
✅ Ramadan schedule modal opens and shows all 29 days (19 Şubat - 19 Mart 2026)
✅ Footer shows developer attribution 'This site was developed by Seyrani Kenger'
✅ Footer shows Diyanet attribution for prayer times data
✅ No layout shifts - page height stable at 1308px
✅ Dark mode is default theme on initial load
✅ Akşam (Iftar) prayer time highlighted with green border and pulsing effect
critical_code_review_comments: Minor ESLint warning: React Hook useCallback in fetchPrayerTimes (line 441) has missing dependency 'processApiData' - low priority
App.js is ~1060 lines - could be modularized but acceptable for current scope
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 requested features are working correctly. The app uses Diyanet API (emushaf.net) for prayer times. Today Feb 19, 2026 is Day 1 of Ramadan 2026, and the app correctly reflects this with Day 1 badge on menu, 3% progress bar, and countdown to Iftar. Menu system shows 7 unique items per day using seeded random algorithm. 29-day Ramadan schedule modal displays dates from Feb 19 - Mar 19, 2026.
